text:
ben_platform: quick heads up — during the shadow rollout of routing-policy v2 we saw token accounting doubles for a handful of tenants in preview invoices. not a full outage but big delta. anyone else seeing this?
sam_sre: saw it too. looks like requests routed to fallback path are being emitted *and* the primary path is still emitting metering events. possible double-count.
maria_billing: confirmed a couple invoice previews for tenant:acme-corp show ~2x token usage for the 2:10-2:20 window. preview only so no customer impact yet but will look bad when enabled.
alice.dev: repro steps? I can probe router logs for duplicate event ids. can you paste a sample?
ben_platform: attaching small snippet from the ingest log (sanitized):
```
{ "request_id":"r-9ab3","tenant_id":"acme-corp","route":"primary","meter_event_id":"m-1234","tokens":42 }
{ "request_id":"r-9ab3","tenant_id":"acme-corp","route":"fallback","meter_event_id":"m-1234","tokens":42 }
```
ben_platform: note same meter_event_id emitted from two outputs.
kevin_prod: that smells like routing switch where we shadow to fallback but forgot to gate emit to only one writer. new policy had 'emit_on_shadow: true' feature flag by default.
sam_sre: yep configuration oversight. router forks requests to both writers when shadow enabled. we should default emit_on_shadow=false.
maria_billing: long-term we need dedupe on meter_event_id in the ingest pipeline. can't trust upstream. dedupe window 5m? suggestions?
alice.dev: +1 dedupe at ingestion layer. but also we need better telemetry to measure how often shadow causes duplicates. current sampling hides it.
ben_platform: what telemetry would help? count of duplicate meter_event_id per tenant per hour, ratio of routes that produce duplicate ids, and alert if >0.1% for paid tenants.
meter-bot: deploy-bot: shadow-router/v2 deployed to canary cluster at 2024-04-26T14:10Z (canary=3 nodes).
kevin_prod: for immediate mitigation set emit_on_shadow=false and roll the flag back in canary; follow-up: add dedupe lambda in ingest with tombstone set in dynamo for 2 minutes.
sam_sre: tombstone works but costy at high QPS. alternative: add a fast in-mem LRU dedupe in the shard writer, then eventual dedupe in DB for misses.
alice.dev: agree. also update console invoice preview to show a 'potential duplicate events' banner when duplicates detected during preview windows. UX should explain it's preview-only.
maria_billing: can we add a temporary compensating job to scan previews and flag affected invoices so finance team doesn't react?
ben_platform: yes, will schedule a one-off scan job for the 2:00-2:30 window and mark preview notes. also put a hold on auto-release of routing-policy v2 until dedupe is in place.
kevin_prod: logging todo: ensure router injects route_tag and meter_event_id into X-Trace so tracing plays nicely. will PR.
alice.dev: i'll own the ingest dedupe prototype. sam, can you change the flag default and coordinate canary rollback?
sam_sre: on it. rolling flag now. will post updates. :thumbsup:
ben_platform: thanks all — excellent triage. follow-ups: (1) flag default change (sam), (2) ingest dedupe proto (alice), (3) console preview banner + hold release (kevin+maria), (4) create telemetry alert + dashboard card (ben). will sync in #eng-platform-ops tomorrow.
meter-bot: alert: duplicate-meter-events >0.05% in canary cluster (3 nodes) — investigating.
alice.dev: noted. starting on prototype now, ETA EOD.
sam_sre: rollback complete on canary. metrics trending back to baseline.
ben_platform: updating runbook to include routing-shadow dedupe checklist. will link in the follow-up thread.
